title: Beyond the Rankings: Travel & Tourism Development Index 2026
gist: WEF webinar on the 2026 Travel & Tourism Development Index covering 100+ economies; the page gives only a description and guest list, no substantive findings.

insights.claim: The 2026 Travel & Tourism Development Index covers more than 100 economies and the webinar addresses where tourism competitiveness progress is accelerating, where vulnerabilities persist and implications for policy, investment and destination strategy.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Index exists as a benchmark; findings not given in this page.

insights.claim: Panelists included Zurich Insurance Group CEO Cara Morton and Saudi Arabia's Deputy Minister for International Relations Hawazen Nassief, with Ramya Krishnaswamy of the WEF.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
entities: Ministry of Tourism of Saudi Arabia
insights.so_what: Signals insurer and Saudi tourism-strategy involvement.
